text: Mechanical Engineering & Automation is a comprehensive discipline integrated with mechanical, electronics and information technology. It is the basis of machinery manufacturing, the mother of any processing industries and the essential power of continuous increase for national economy.Teaching Obiective Basic and professional knowledge and applied ability about general mechanical design, manufacture and automation and design of polymer materials processing machinery are trained in this major. The students will be cultivated to be senior engineering and technical personnel who can do works about design, manufacture, scientific research development, applied research, operational guidance and management trade etc in the field of mechanical engineering and automation.Main Course The main courses of this major are theoretical mechanics, material mechanics, mechanical principle, engineering materials & basis of machine, interchangeability & testing technique, mechanical design, mechatronics technology, mechanism manufacturing process, control theory for mechanical engineering, mechatronics transmission and control, metal cutting principle and cutting tool, NC machining technology, hydrostatic transmission, advanced manufacturing technology, non–traditional machining, design of rubber machinery, basis of polymer process.Degree Award & Career This major has the authorization of PhD degree, master’s degree and bachelor’s degree. After graduated, the students can get in graduate stage to pursue advanced studies; also can go to work at organization about mechanical manufacture, mechanical and electronic, polymer materials processing machinery etc. The job may concern design, manufacture, research and development, producing management, trade or sale etc. Some of the students can get in ALPS Company (Japan) realizing international employment. The students of this major have a broad career space and a great market need, so employment status of this major is good.
